core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nadiah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Tender, delicate”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nadiah corresponds to the Arabic form نَدِيَّة (Arabic root ن د و (n-d-w); نَدِيَّة (Nadiyya)). Its core sense is nadiaa; tender, delicate (feminine). Nadiah is Arabic نَدِيَّة (Nadiyya) 'tender, delicate' (feminine), from the root ن د و (n-d-w). The source gloss 'Tender, delicate, gentle' is consistent. Same name as nadia.
